note: Eighty-two things a player would actually say to their assistant while playing — `node evals/select.mjs` prints the count it scored, and every one of these is scored in every state that publishes its tool. None of them names a tool, because a player does not know the tool names — that is the whole point of the exercise. `intended` is the tool that should win; `also` is a tool that would be a defensible second reading and is not counted against the score. The published surface speaks for the whole cast through one tool, post_as_character, so a phrase about Vance or the reporter wants that one.
